findings.claim: SpaceX 於 Q2 財報電話會議稱將把 Starlink 星座定位為完整行動電信業者（直接面對 Verizon、AT&T、T-Mobile），並已購入 EchoStar 頻譜，由批發漫遊轉向自有頻譜平台
findings.source: SatNews: SpaceX reports strong Q2 results and details direct mobile telco strategy
findings.excerpt: Shotwell stated that SpaceX is positioning its Starlink satellite constellation to operate as a full-fledged mobile telecommunications carrier. The strategy targets market share among the primary U.S. wireless carriers—Verizon, AT&T, and T-Mobile—a group that generates approximately $600 billion (€520 billion) in annual revenue.

findings.claim: SpaceX 自 2026-06 起不再透過通訊社發布財報，改在投資人關係網站與 X 帳號發布；另報導 2026-05 Starlink 方案漲價最多 $10/月
findings.source: BYDFi: SpaceX drops wire services for earnings disclosures
